Terms and Conditions (1) The items covered under AMC and the parts/components will be repaired / replaced by the Contractor at no cost basis, as and when considered necessar y, PCBs & Plastic parts which are not mishandled or damaged due to conditions such as mice bite etc are also covered under AMC contract. (2) The following parts/components are not included in AMC:- (i) Toner (ii) OPC Drum (iii) Developer (iv) Glass (3) Firm shall take prompt action to attend the complaint/maintenance calls made on telephone or other means & they should ensure serviceability of equip ment within 24 hrs. Besides that they should also make at least two visits in a week to ensure smooth functioning of the plotter. 4. Regular maintenance / checkup shall be carried out of all equipment onc e in a month as per manufacturer’s instructions/ guidance. 4.1 If complaint will not be attended within 48 hours, the penalty @ R s.350/- per day shall be deducted from AMC bill. The cumulative penalty ca nnot exceed 10% of the contract value for that period as per Para 03 of GeM provisions. 4.2 A register will be maintained at E-1 (Stores) Section of HQ CEJZ. Complaint shall be entered in register by Section In charge. The compl aints shall be noted daily by contractor. When the complaint is attended s ame shall be entered by contractor. The Section head will sign in confir mation of complaint attended. 4.3 The Plotter KIP 7170i will be checked before signing the contract, jointly by the rep of HQ CEJZ and contractor. 4.4 Payment will be made quarterly basis after satisfactory performa nce. 4.5 This is the entire Agreement between the parties and no alteratio n or amendment is valid. 4.6 A qualified personnel with minimum three years experience shall be employed by contractor for repairs & maintenance of the items.

. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 7. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
